### Fixed

- **Integration cards** — tall 1x2 cards use a filled 6-cell grid (CPU/RAM + service stats) with no empty gap
- **Richer stats** — Radarr, Sonarr, Prowlarr, Bazarr, qBittorrent, Pi-hole, AdGuard, Overseerr, Uptime Kuma, and more show 4–6 useful API fields per card
- **Live refresh** — integration stats refresh every 30s while the card is visible

### Upgrade

```bash
docker compose pull && docker compose up -d --force-recreate
```

Hard-refresh after upgrade (`Ctrl+Shift+R`). Re-save integration apps once if cards are still 1x1 from an older layout.
